description: This file defines a PDO wrapper class for database interactions in the Opencart system, including connection setup, query execution, and utility methods.

classes.name: PDO
classes.description: A wrapper class for PHP's PDO to manage database connections and queries within Opencart.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the database connection with provided options, sets session variables.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query using prepared statements, returns result object or boolean.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Creates a named parameter placeholder for safe SQL queries.

methods.name: countAffected
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: getLastId
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted auto-increment ID.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the database connection is active.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the database connection when the object is destroyed.
